notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
Fixed freezes from a large number of effects.
 Fixed lags when turning off effects.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
The latest changes in the game:

 Added a new card type.
 Fixed the problem with the name of the numbers.
 Added new names for the numbers.
 Boss kill and potion challenges now work.
 Fixed full-screen mode.
 Fixed control and alt work.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
The latest changes in the game:

 Changed the requirements for the fourth chest.
 Changed heroes guild balance.
 Fixed the mage's staff (artifact).
 Fixed Legionnaire's card.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
The latest changes in the game:

 Added the power of magic to the magic guild.
 Shop was improved.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
The latest changes in the game:

 Changed effect of the stars of the magic guild.
 Bonuses of the magic guild are increased.
 Improvements now apply to the Tungus map.
 Additional tutorials have been added.
 Added effect for golden toad.
 We tried to make the game more dynamic, especially at the beginning.

notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
Now you can resize the game window.
 Added saving daily bonus deck upgrades.
 Fixed errors in descriptions.
 Fixed counting of fireflies from the shop and hero's skills.
 Increased power of ether cards.
 Added log to the game itself.
 Added additional guild leaving hints.
